summary: Reproduced the exact gated ModelOpt NVFP4 MoE post-load assertion with the Gemma-4 TP=2 dimensions, then adapted the existing unmerged upstream PR #30888 candidate to current main. The correction pads each gate/up half independently before swizzling and pads the corresponding packed w2 weights and block scales.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction on prepared base behavior: warning w2_weight_scale shape=(1, 2816, 22), followed by the reported gated-padding AssertionError. Raw output: reports/j-2708bd88fe6e/raw/failing_before.txt

Passing-after post-load regression, aligned no-op control, malformed-layout boundary cases, and related NVFP4 scale tests: 17 passed and 38 subtests passed. Raw output: reports/j-2708bd88fe6e/raw/passing_after.txt

On the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950, verified 352-channel gate/up marker tensors become independently padded 384-channel halves and matching w2 widths become 192 packed columns and 24 scale columns. Raw output: reports/j-2708bd88fe6e/raw/gpu_padding_check.txt

gpu_execution_evidence: Tensor-level padding helper executed on the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X with ROCm 7.2 and preserved gate/up boundaries; this is not NVIDIA NVFP4 kernel or TP serving validation.
remaining_limitations: The assigned environment has one AMD gfx950 GPU, not two NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, and the 26B NVFP4 model weights were unavailable. Therefore the original TP=2 CUDA/FlashInfer CUTLASS server load and generation were not rerun here. Upstream PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/30888 reports a two-B300 load/generation validation, but that external claim is not treated as local hardware evidence. No native C++ or FlyDSL source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
